Aangóon (Angoon)

Aangóon (Angoon) is a Tlingit village on Admiralty Island in Southeast Alaska. The Alaska Marine Highway System places the village on the southwest coast of Kootznahoo Inlet.

Read the sources [1] Alaska Marine Highway System

01

Angoon on Admiralty Island

The Alaska Marine Highway System places Angoon southwest of Juneau and northeast of Sitka, beside Kootznahoo Inlet. It identifies Killesnoo Harbor in its Angoon port listing.

Read the sources [1] Alaska Marine Highway System

02

Local cultural programs

Tlingit & Haida’s Angoon community page lists a vest-making workshop and a cedar hat weaving workshop. The listings offer two starting points for exploring cultural programming in Angoon.

Read the sources [2] Tlingit & Haida

03

The 1882 bombardment and the 2024 apology

In 1882 the U.S. Navy bombarded Angoon, destroying homes, canoes and stored food. Yvonne Krumrey reports that representatives from Angoon sought an apology for decades. On October 26, 2024, people gathered in the Angoon High School gym, where Rear Admiral Mark Sucato apologized on behalf of the Navy.

Read the sources [3] KTOO

What needs further research

  • Additional accounts by Angoon residents would deepen the community history.
